zitat: The current evidence shows that in the normal population, caffeine acutely enhances attention by improving both reaction time and accuracy.
Wert Bericht neben dem RT-Eintrag der selben Metaanalyse
After pooling data in the meta-analysis, the significant impacts of caffeine only emerged on attention, accuracy, and speed.
The consumption of energy drinks was found to have a small positive effect on reaction time, whilst the use of beta-alanine, carbohydrate, and caffeine had no effect.
caffeine ingestion induced a higher positive or success rate of actions during real or simulated competition (SMD: 0.44; 95% CI, 0.19-0.69).
Caffeine significantly improved response speed (Hedges' g = 1.11, 95% CI: 0.75-1.47, p < 0.001, I2 = 73.4%) on the reaction time tasks (Figure 4).
